summary: Friday's close capped a brutal week of de-risking: the VIX pushed near 36, over four standard deviations above average, as equities and bitcoin extended steep losses into deep capitulation. A firm dollar and elevated real yields kept gold pinned even as stocks fell, leaving bonds as the week's lone safe-haven beneficiary.
tweet: VIX near 36, bitcoin in deep capitulation, gold capped by a firm dollar — bonds were the only refuge as the week's risk-off slide intensified into Friday's close.
